messages:
ash: Quick sync - NexusWave asked for a Redwood marketplace listing + joint announcement. Scope: SSO (SAML), SCIM provisioning, KMS (HSM-backed) connector. Need a checklist and rollout plan.

marta: Sounds good. High level checklist: 1) KMS lab cert (keywrap, rotate, perf), 2) SCIM CI pass, 3) SAML metadata exchange & docs, 4) legal/compliance signoff, 5) marketing blurb + assets.

liam: I can run KMS tests. Need partner HSM test endpoint + REST API keys. Quick KMS smoke: create key, wrap/unwrap, rotate, verify telemetry. ETA 8 business days after access.

ash: SAML - do we require automated SSO test or is metadata + manual verification OK?

marta: For marketplace badge we require SAML metadata and a successful login test with one IdP. SCIM must pass our CI to get "auto-provisioning" badge.

liam: Note: connector exposes KMIP and REST; certify REST for listing and mark KMIP as enterprise-only.

ops-bot: created playbook /playbooks/partners/nexuswave/cert-checklist (by marta) :white_check_mark:

tanya: I'll draft marketplace copy and request partner logo. Need final feature list (algorithms, key sizes, limitations) from eng.

eva: I'll review partner EULA and HSM vendor attestations for export controls and SOC reports. Please attach docs before we publish claims about compliance.

marta: Short SCIM curl sample for CI (will be used in suite):
curl -X POST 'https://scim.nexuswave.test/v2/Users' -H 'Authorization: Bearer $CI_TOKEN' -d '{"userName":"ci.test"}'

liam: Perf target: P95 < 200ms for wrap/unwrap under 50 concurrent ops. We'll capture baseline in lab.

ash: Proposed owners & dates:
- KMS lab report: liam -> 2027-02-20
- SCIM CI & report: marta -> 2027-02-16
- SAML verification: ash -> 2027-02-14
- Marketing assets: tanya -> 2027-02-18
- Legal signoff: eva -> 2027-02-21

marta: I'll enable partner namespace and debug flag for pilot customers and wire alerts to #eng-oncall for >3% KMS error sustained 5m.

ash: OK. let's aim for a soft launch with 2 pilots, then public listing after 30 days if metrics look good. Check-in in 3 business days. :thumbsup:
